name: enterprise-playwright-ai-skill-pack
description: Governed Playwright skill pack for AI coding agents: 64 narrow skills, signed and hash-locked, enforced by managed settings, hooks, policy and CI.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:pack && npm run verify:code
scripts.verify:pack: node scripts/verify-lock.mjs --quiet && node scripts/check-skills.mjs && node scripts/check-allowed-tools.mjs && node scripts/skill-scan.mjs && node scripts/check-prompts.mjs && node scripts/gen-docs.mjs --check
scripts.verify:code: node scripts/validate-config.mjs && tsc --noEmit && eslint --no-inline-config --max-warnings=0 . && playwright test --list
